_comment: Model router: one picker, three backends. Fable 5 → OpenRouter GLM 5.2 :nitro (fastest provider). Opus 4.8 → Z.ai GLM 5.2 (subscription; run cowork-zai-login). Sonnet 5 → OpenAI GPT-5.5 (ChatGPT subscription; run cowork-openai-login). ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN is your OpenRouter key — used for the Fable route; the Z.ai and OpenAI backends use their own OAuth credentials. No fallback: each model maps to exactly one backend.
